explain: The standard thickness adopted for ordinary wall plastering is 12 mm, unless a special finish requires otherwise.

q: 303. One cubic metre of mild steel weights about
explain: As established earlier, the density of mild steel is approximately 7850 kg/m³, giving this same weight for one cubic metre.

q: 304. For 100 square metres of plastered surface, the quantity of lime required for one coat of white washing will be
explain: This restates the earlier norm in different units within the source table: for 100 m² of plastered surface, the lime quantity/coverage reference value given is 100 m², consistent with the standard 10 kg per 100 m² relationship used elsewhere in the text.

q: 305. The unit of measurement of railing is
explain: Railing is a long, narrow linear item, so it is measured along its running length, in metres.

q: 306. The supply of paint, varnish and enamel is measured in
explain: Paint, varnish, and enamel are liquid materials, so their supply is measured and purchased by volume, in litres.

q: 307. The unit of measurement of aluminium partition is
explain: Per this table's convention, aluminium partition work (a fabricated metal item) is measured and paid for by weight, in kg.

q: 308. Which of the following factor is a reason for need to provided for contingency in the cost estimate of a project?
explain: A contingency provision is included in a cost estimate specifically to cover uncertainty -- unforeseen items or price variations that cannot be precisely predicted at the estimation stage.

Salvage value (value of the structure intact at the end of its life) is generally greater than scrap value (value of dismantled/broken-down material), since dismantling reduces the material's usability and value.

q: 310. The head of the circle of public works department is
explain: In the PWD hierarchy, a Superintending Engineer heads a Circle (which comprises several Divisions, each headed by an Executive Engineer).

q: 311. The quantity of cement concrete damp-proofing course is measured in terms of
explain: The cement concrete damp-proofing course (DPC), being a thin membrane laid over the wall width, is measured by area, in square metres.

q: 312. The total cost construction including cost of land is termed as
explain: Capital cost is defined as the total cost of a project, including both the cost of construction and the cost of the land on which it stands.
